laws.title: Damped spring with air drag and cubic stiffness, with a periodic drive

derivatives.v: -w*w*(s - s_eq) - gamma*v - q*v*abs(v) - alpha*(s - s_eq)*(s - s_eq)*(s - s_eq) + F_drive*cos(w_drive*t + phi_drive)

laws.title: Damped nonlinear spring with periodic drive and linearly drifting equilibrium

derivatives.v: -w*w*(s - (s_eq + drift*t)) - gamma*v - q*v*abs(v) - alpha*(s - (s_eq + drift*t))^3 + F_drive*cos(w_drive*t + phi_drive)
